title: EDA Integration Definition
description: Schema for Event-Driven Ansible integration definitions

id.description: Unique identifier using lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (e.g., 'prometheus-alert')

description.description: Brief description of the integration and its purpose

authTypes.description: Supported authentication methods for this integration

examplePayload.description: Sample JSON payload representing a typical event from this source

payloadSchema.description: Optional JSON Schema for validating payloads (useful for form generation)

documentation.description: URL to official documentation for this integration

tags.description: Searchable tags for filtering and discovery
